description: Source code for a tool that generates and uploads Breakpad symbol files for OS X system libraries, involving directory scanning, Mach-O file analysis, symbol dumping, and uploading.

classes.name: WorkerPool
classes.description: Manages a pool of worker goroutines executing a given function.

classes.name: UploadQueue
classes.description: Manages a queue of symbol files to be uploaded with worker goroutines.

classes.name: DumpQueue
classes.description: Manages a queue of files for symbol dumping, with optional upload integration.

classes.name: dumpRequest
classes.description: Represents a request to dump symbols for a specific file and architecture.

classes.name: findQueue
classes.description: Handles directory traversal and Mach-O file detection for symbol dumping.

methods.name: StartWorkerPool
methods.description: Launches a specified number of worker goroutines executing a given function.

methods.name: StartUploadQueue
methods.description: Creates an upload queue with worker goroutines for uploading symbol files.

methods.name: Upload
methods.description: Enqueues a symbol file path for uploading.

methods.name: Done
methods.description: Signals that no more files will be enqueued for upload.

methods.name: StartDumpQueue
methods.description: Creates a dump queue to find and process Mach-O files for symbol dumping.

methods.name: DumpSymbols
methods.description: Enqueues a file for symbol dumping for a specific architecture.

methods.name: Wait
methods.description: Waits for all worker goroutines in the pool to complete.

methods.name: uploadFromDirectory
methods.description: Uploads all symbol files found in a specified directory.
